hero.title:
Service. Education.
Harmony.
hero.text: Founded on the vision of Syedna Khuzaima Qutbuddin RA, Zahra Hasanaat uplifts communities through education, healthcare, financial inclusion, interfaith dialogue, and compassionate service.

welcome.arabic: الخلق عيال الله، واحب الخلق الى الله انفعهم لعياله
welcome.quote: “All of creation are the children of God, and the most beloved to God of those children is the one who benefits His children the most.”
welcome.body: Established in 1996, Zahra Hasanaat helps individuals and families realise their aspirations in health, education, and finance — guided by the belief that upliftment, not charity, benefits both the giver and the receiver and builds a society rooted in dignity, harmony, and compassion.

programs.title: Education
programs.text: The Qutbi Jubilee Scholarship Program supports students from primary school through higher education with scholarships, mentorship, and career guidance.

programs.title: Interfaith
programs.text: Taqreeb fosters inter- and intra-faith understanding through academic conferences, grassroots community service, and dialogue.

programs.title: Health
programs.text: Medical camps, mental health awareness, dental care, eye care, insurance guidance, and wellness webinars for underserved communities.

programs.title: Financial Advisory
programs.text: Financial literacy, livelihood support, small business loans, and advisory services to help families achieve economic stability.

programs.title: Food Security
programs.text: Food distribution programs ensuring no family goes hungry, guided by the Qur’anic principle of feeding and clothing those in need.

programs.title: Mazaar-e-Qutbi
programs.text: Raudat-un-Noor — the mausoleum of Syedna Khuzaima Qutbuddin RA in Thane, Maharashtra. A place of peace, reflection, and community welfare.

feature.title: Raudat-un-Noor
feature.text: The mausoleum of the 53rd Dai al-Mutlaq, Syedna Khuzaima Qutbuddin RA, in Thane, Maharashtra — “an embodiment of knowledge and light.” A place of peace and reflection, home to a social welfare centre serving the surrounding community.

cta.title: Make a Difference Today
cta.text: Whether through a donation, volunteering your time, or applying for support — every action creates ripples of positive change.
